title: Formalize the accepted M1-M5 decision set
goal: Commit the accepted milestone decision records and their shared maintained indexes as one exact documentation checkpoint before product implementation.
acceptanceCriteria: All seven M1-M5 milestone decision Markdown/JSON pairs are preserved and committed with the maintained architecture, product-index and backlog updates.
The discussion-memory directory is ignored and remains non-authoritative.
Every changed documentation path is declared by this root Plan and unknown build outputs remain unstaged.
No product, contract, test, workflow, ruleset, package, consumer repository, release or remote state changes occur.
risks: Shared product-document ownership across milestone records could make a composed Plan ambiguous without this root checkpoint.
Accepted decisions could be mistaken for implementation or remote-change authorization.
decisions: Use one exact documentation root Plan for the shared M1-M5 formalization diff.
Keep milestone Plan pairs as semantic decision records and require separate exact Plans for implementation.
Keep discussion memory ignored and non-authoritative.
